0022600139.text: The Timberwolves (3-1, 1-0 at home) host the Warriors (1-3) in Minnesota's fifth game of the season. Minnesota is 3rd in the Northwest, one game back, and 6th in the West after a one-game losing streak, while Golden State is 4th in the Pacific, two games back, and 12th in the West on a one-game winning streak. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), and Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), with Yaxel Lendeborg (foot) listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 127-117 win in San Francisco on March 13, 2026.
